explication: bottom is a cross-platform terminal system monitor. Its main workflow collects host and process metrics, keeps application data and interaction state, then presents configurable widgets and accepts user actions such as searching, changing focus, and terminating processes. The README documents the major visualization, table, configuration, basic-mode, and expansion capabilities. Some subsystem links below rely on README descriptions or SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
